ownership: external; neither V2 nor V3 prior predictive

document.action_schedule: do(action)=time mod 2; action selection is never scored

targets.identity: binary root state -> binary identity observation
targets.outcome: danger and do(action) prevention -> realized danger -> binary outcome observation
targets.partner: two-state Markov chain with transition [[.88,.12],[.12,.88]] -> response observation
targets.contact: partner state and intervened policy -> contact-response observation

grid_selection: nearest to .20, .50, .80; ties numeric then canonical name; no model score differences
